subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the nighttime back courtyard of Shenji Silk Shop in <Picture 1>, a small open-air yard enclosed by three grey-brick walls, with a wooden post carrying a lit hanging lantern at its center, a pottery water vat with a half-open wooden lid against the left wall, drying racks with plain cloth along the right eave, and a closed accounting-room door at the far end.
<Subject 2> is Shen Zhao in <Picture 2>, a composed young woman in moon-white robes under a black sleeveless over-vest, standing upright with a steady gaze and holding the fire lighter in her right hand.
<Subject 3> is Shen Yanzhou in <Picture 3>, a tall, calm male steward in a deep-blue narrow-sleeved robe with a black sleeveless over-jacket, standing half a step behind and beside Shen Zhao.
<Subject 4> is the fire lighter in <Picture 4>, a short dark-brown bamboo-and-paper cylinder with a copper cap ring, a scraped seam, and a tiny carved character on its body.

summary:

detailed_description:
The target video uses next-generation 3D Chinese-animation rendering, with a warm yellow lantern circle descending from the courtyard's central post, cool blue night light spilling over the wall tops, a low-saturation nocturnal palette, and highly resolved matte brick, glazed pottery, old wood, and translucent lantern paper. The finish matches the dense nocturnal lighting of Chang An and the tense night-alley standoffs of The Degenerate-Drawing Jianghu Season 6. The scene takes place deep at night in <Subject 1>, where the lantern on the wooden post forms a shrinking circle of light on the brick ground while the wall bases and courtyard corners sink into darkness. At the beginning, the characters preserve the previous storyboard's ending positions exactly: <Subject 2> stands directly beneath the hanging lantern at the center of the courtyard, facing the right-front of frame with <Subject 4> gripped in her right hand and her left arm hanging naturally, while <Subject 3> stands half a step behind and beside her, turned toward her profile.

[Shot 1] A medium close shot at eye level uses a centered composition with the lantern post as a vertical line above the frame. The camera pushes in slowly and evenly as warm lantern light falls from above and carves the edge of <Subject 2>'s shoulder while her long shadow stretches across the brick ground toward the closed accounting-room door. <Subject 2> stands still, her jaw set, her gaze steady and level, her lips pressed into a straight line, her right hand closed around <Subject 4>. Night insects chirp steadily and the lantern paper rustles faintly in the still air. The centered figure inside a shrinking pool of light conveys quiet, contained pressure.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.200, the shot cuts to a locked macro close-up of <Subject 2>'s right hand gripping <Subject 4>, with shallow depth of field and warm lantern light falling from above. Her thumb slides slowly across the tiny carved character on the cylinder body, and the carved stroke forms a fine shadow under her fingertip. <Subject 2> (S1), physically motionless with her hand raised near her chest, emotionally controlled and intent, and intending to trace the origin of the fire, says in an off-screen voiceover using her mapped clear, cool-toned young female voice, in the mid-low register, at low volume, at medium-slow speed, with even breath and a decisive downward ending: <d>[Chinese] 三年前的火是从内院烧起来的。</d> Her on-screen lips remain completely closed. Sleeve fabric brushes softly as her thumb moves.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.700, the shot cuts to a locked close shot of <Subject 2>'s face framed from the shoulders up, with the lower half of her face lit by warm lantern light and the upper half falling into shadow. Her eyes lower toward <Subject 4>, then lift slowly toward <Subject 3>; her breathing stays slow and even. <Subject 2> (S1), physically still, emotionally cold and resolute, and intending to name the true target, continues in the same off-screen voiceover using her mapped voice at low volume, at medium-slow speed, with a slight pause between clauses and a heavy, downward landing on the final words: <d>[Chinese] 给我火折子的人，比柳如烟更想让我死。</d> Her on-screen lips remain completely closed throughout.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.700, the shot cuts to a medium close shot of <Subject 3> framed over <Subject 2>'s shoulder, with <Subject 2>'s shoulder as a dark foreground edge. The camera holds steady with a very slight breathing sway. <Subject 3> lowers his eyes to <Subject 4> in <Subject 2>'s hand, then raises them to her face, his expression flat and his shoulders square. <Subject 3> (S2), physically standing half a step behind her with his hands at his sides, emotionally steady and factual, and intending to report who could obtain an inner-courtyard fire lighter, says in his mapped steady, clear mid-low male voice, at medium volume, at medium speed, with regular pauses and precise enunciation of every name: <d>[Chinese] 东家，内院的火折子，只有太夫人、世子爷、</d> The line continues across the cut without a gap.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a close shot of <Subject 2> listening, her face held in the warm edge of the lantern light with the dark courtyard behind her. Her eyes narrow slightly and her right thumb presses once, hard, against the cylinder of <Subject 4>. <Subject 3> (S2) continues in the same mapped voice at medium volume, at medium speed, with regular pauses and clear stress on each name: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>各房姨娘和内院的嬷嬷能拿到。</d> <Subject 2>'s lips stay closed while she listens. A faint breath escapes through her nose, and the leather-like friction of her thumb against the cylinder is audible.

[Shot 6] At 00:11.800, the shot cuts to a frontal close shot of <Subject 2> at eye level with a shallow depth of field locking her eyes. She lifts her chin slightly, her gaze fixed forward, and her expression settles into flat calm. <Subject 2> (S1), physically upright and composed, emotionally resolved, and intending to open the investigation, says in her mapped clear, cool-toned young female voice in the mid-low register, at medium volume, at slow speed, with level breath and a decisive downward ending: <d>[Chinese] 那就从王嬷嬷开始查。</d> As the last word lands, she turns her body toward the accounting-room door, and the fabric of her sleeve swings with the turn.

[Shot 7] At 00:13.500, the shot cuts to a medium wide shot from behind, held static at hip height with the lantern post entering the top of the frame. <Subject 2> walks toward the closed accounting-room door with <Subject 3> following half a step behind and slightly to her side; the lantern light throws both of their shadows far forward across the brick ground, stretching and narrowing as they move away from the light source. Their footfalls land on the brick with steady, unhurried weight, night insects continue, and the lantern paper sways faintly behind them. The final frame holds on the two receding backs and the two long shadows reaching toward the accounting-room door, completing the progression from the fire lighter in her hand to the decision to investigate, and preparing the next segment at the accounting room.

Sleeve and thumb friction accompany the close shots of the fire lighter, followed by unhurried footfalls on brick and a soft cloth swing as the two figures turn and walk away.
